Dear family, peace be with you all. Hello, everyone. We are here for "Unlocking the Heart Every Week." We have been talking about body, mind, and spirit environmental protection. How do we practice body, mind, and spirit environmental protection? It is actually a circular, unified concept.

When our thoughts are polluted and negative ideas enter, they create negative desires or emotions, which then manifest in our external words and behaviors. In the end, this, in turn, affects our own body, mind, and spirit.

Therefore, if our body, mind, and spirit are not grounded in mindfulness, this internal environmental protection will not be successful. We can use "Unlocking the Heart Every Week" to practice this body, mind, and spirit environmental protection together every week. Today, we humbly invite Mr. Su Niu to share his compassion with us.
